indicator.name: Households receiving cash transfer or social assistance
indicator.description: Percentage of households receiving a cash transfer or any social assistance in KDHS 2022 Table 2.21.3C.
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published directly for all 47 counties. This is a household survey percentage broader than Inua Jamii, not an administrative beneficiary count. Household denominators are retained; confidence intervals are not fabricated and ranking is withheld.

observations.source_table: Table 2.21.3C — Cash transfer or social assistance by county
observations.notes: Direct KDHS 2022 Table 2.21.3C household percentage; published household denominator 424; displayed households receiving assistance 83. Broader than Inua Jamii and not a beneficiary-person count. No confidence interval is fabricated, ranking is withheld, and no lower-level inheritance is applied.
